description: Desktop ATX +5VSB standby rail. Always present whenever the PSU is plugged into mains (even when the system is 'off'). Powers the RTC, super-IO, EC, wake-on-LAN, and the PS_ON# pull-up. Distinct from the laptop +5VALW concept — laptops derive standby from the adapter/battery through an on-board buck; desktops get it pre-regulated from the PSU.

typical_voltage_v.notes: ATX12V spec: 4.75-5.25 V. Must be present whenever the PSU IEC lead is live.

psu_signal_notes: 5VSB must NOT be loaded beyond the ATX spec (typically 2 A max for older PSUs, 3 A for modern). Overloading 5VSB causes the PSU to drop it and the board will not start.
